# Identities

## Supported identities scenarios

* Receiving an identity for a customer organisation.

For the business rules concerning identities, please read [Organizations](https://developer.floriday.io/docs/organisations).

<br />

***

## Receiving identities

**Purpose:**\
Receive identity information from a customer on Floriday.

<br />

**Prerequisites:**

* API key is generated by customer on Floriday;
* API key used is up to date.

<br />

| NR | Process step                             | API call / scenario                                                                                              |
| :- | :--------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1  | Returns an identity based on an API key. | *[GetIdentity](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2026v1/swagger/index.html#/Identities/GetIdentity)* |
